name: Bot nhuc
summary: Bột nhúc is an old Chứt staple and, with cơm pồi, one of the characteristic foods of the villages around the park.
origin: Chứt villages in the Phong Nha-Ke Bang buffer.
culture: It sits with bột báng, củ nâu, and củ mài among the older Chứt staples.
howToEat: Ask in the Chứt villages of the buffer whether a family is making it.
seoTitle: Bot nhuc — a Chut staple at Phong Nha
seoDescription: Bột nhúc is an old Chứt staple and, with cơm pồi, a characteristic food of the villages around Phong Nha-Ke Bang.
